svg.aria-label: Left: unique non-parameter backing storage retained for backward after forward, including full input storage retained by a slice; this is not process peak memory. Upper right compares gradients except the DDP row, which compares parameters after SGD. Lower right shows real type conversions. All checks use the same 96 examples and parameter initialization.
